program.name: AI-Roadmap
program.subtitle: Two pathways. One progression from understanding to workplace proof.
program.cadence: 2 live sessions a week · Day 1 and Day 2
program.holidayNote: One-week holiday pause; its position depends on the confirmed start date
scope: Not developer training; no agent building
No certification or accreditation offered or implied
Panel review and five-minute defence are proposed, pending approval
Learners use permitted workplace data or safe mock data, subject to OSBI governance

beats.name: Spark
beats.line: Open with a real GenAI use case from one OSBI function.

beats.name: Build
beats.line: Hands-on work through the learner's own function.

beats.name: Reflect
beats.line: Two or three prompts and one thing I'll do differently.

roles.name: Panel
roles.line: Challenges the final case, if approved.

roles.name: The learner
roles.line: Owns the problem and the outcome.

pathways.name: AI Practitioner
pathways.line: Copilot fluency, responsible use, and adoption that spreads to peers.

facts.v: Adjacent to technology, not inside it
Copilot Chat with file upload; no M365 integration
An adopted workflow others can copy
Peers. The learner spreads the practice
Responsible AI and permitted data boundaries

objectives.title: Explain the machine
objectives.line: How Copilot produces an output, and why instructions change it.

objectives.title: Build reusable patterns
objectives.line: Prompt templates that hold up in daily work, not just in a demo.

objectives.title: Judge the fit
objectives.line: Which tasks suit AI, which do not, and why.

objectives.title: Work inside the boundary
objectives.line: Governance rules on permitted data and external tools.

objectives.title: Carry the room
objectives.line: Make the case to peers and managers, and defend it.

mindset.from: AI is magic, or a threat
mindset.to: AI predicts; I direct it and I check it

mindset.from: AI helps me with a task
mindset.to: AI changes how my workflow runs
I can prove it and spread it

pulse: I know what AI can and cannot do in my role.
I check AI output before I use it.
I reach for AI first on drafting and summarising tasks.
I can name a workflow in my team that AI could improve.
I have helped a colleague use AI well.

pathways.name: Data Citizen
pathways.line: Raw data to decision-ready insight, without waiting on an analyst.

facts.v: Business roles where technology is not the core
Excel, data preparation, dashboards, AI assistance; pending tool confirmation
A decision-ready insight, not a report request

objectives.title: Prepare it fast
objectives.line: Turn raw or unstructured data into an analysis-ready dataset.

objectives.title: Answer the question
objectives.line: Reach the answer without raising a request to someone else.

objectives.title: Check the answer
objectives.line: Judge whether the analysis is sound before acting on it.

objectives.title: Show the story
objectives.line: A dashboard a decision-maker reads without explanation.

objectives.title: Protect the data
objectives.line: Quality, privacy, and governance judgment on what they touch.

objectives.title: Land the decision
objectives.line: Connect the insight to a decision, and defend the reasoning.

mindset.to: Data is evidence I can question

mindset.from: Raise a request, wait for a report
mindset.to: Prepare, analyse and check it myself
A decision-ready view my team uses
A defended decision others act on

pulse: I can tell whether a dataset is fit to use.
I can answer a routine business question without raising a request.
I check an analysis before acting on it.
I can present a finding a decision-maker understands without explanation.
I know what data I may share, upload or combine.
